title: Theory Trace Card: Theory-Driven Socio-Cognitive Evaluation of LLMs
reasoning: The paper identifies moral reasoning as a primary socio-cognitive capability to be evaluated. It discusses theoretical frameworks like Moral Foundations Theory and uses morality-focused benchmarks (e.g., ETHICS, CMoralEval, and the Theory of Dyadic Morality) as core examples and worked cases for the proposed Theory Trace Card system.
